name: Ghost
author: Ferdous Bhai
description: An owner-local AI persona with its own character, tools, and desktop reach: summoned, it lights the screen edges and listens; it works in the background and answers in a card. History and settings open like the desktop's own menu, and the bar mark shows its state in herdr's colours. Needs the ghost package for the daemon. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle ferdousbhai.ghost

barWidget.description: A dot that reports the ghost's state and opens its window.
